label: OUTCOME-FREE INPUT CENSUS - not a result; revised analysis, not confirmatory
values_not_read: returns, prices, dividends, cost values, tax results, NAV, Sharpe, any performance summary
definition_panel_exit: present at month t and absent at month t+1 in the named panel; NOT inferred to be a delisting
definition_held: weights-file row with w != 0 (identifier membership test only)
projection_note: projected_unresolved_share applies the carry_v1 rule: a held name with no C6 row at a date (the engine's priced_at test) and no exit evidence is unresolved from that date on, and NAV is NaN from the first unresolved month. Derived from membership alone; it counts only names with a non-zero weight in a scored month, so it is an approximation, and is not a result
